name: Furukawa Electric Co., Ltd.
blurb: Furukawa Electric is a Japanese industrial conglomerate producing copper and fiber-optic cables, electronic materials, automotive components, and industrial equipment. Its optical communications division — now spun into a global joint venture called Lightera (launched April 2025) comprising operations in Japan, the United States, and Latin America — is a major fiber-cable manufacturer competing with Corning, Prysmian, and Sumitomo for hyperscaler and telco contracts.
recent: In March 2026, Lightera (Furukawa's fiber JV) began mass production of a 13,824-count optical fiber cable at its Mie Works plant in Japan — among the world's highest fiber-density cables — targeting hyperscale data centers. The ADR trades as FUWAY on OTC markets. Like Sumitomo, Furukawa is a conglomerate where the fiber division is one of several major business lines, meaning AI-optics upside is real but partially diluted at the consolidated level.
